parts.text: "Hello, Andrew. I've been doing well, thank you for asking. It's so good to finally catch up after everything that's been going on." *sits back down into the chair, leaning forward slightly with an eager expression* "I remember when we first met at that conference a few years ago, and you showed me your passion for data visualization. Do you still find that aspect of my work as intriguing as I do? It means a lot to me to know it's meaningful to someone like you."
